title: Prompt safety (AEGIS 2.0 test prompts)
decision: whether a user prompt to an AI assistant is unsafe (the data set's human prompt label)

source.name: AEGIS 2.0 / Nemotron Content Safety Dataset V2 (Ghosh et al., NAACL 2025)

notes: gold yes = prompt_label 'unsafe', no = 'safe'; rows: 500 yes + 500 no. Test split: 1964 rows. Dropped: 36 redacted prompts (text 'REDACTED', to be rebuilt from a set the card does not distribute; 16 safe, 20 unsafe), 0 blank prompts, 12 repeats of 12 prompt texts that occur more than once with one label (lowest id kept) and 2 rows of 1 prompt text(s) that carry both labels (texts compared after case folding and collapsing white space). Pool after filtering: 884 safe, 1030 unsafe; 500 per class drawn with random.Random(20261007) after sorting by id. Label caveat: prompt_label_source is 'human' for every row, and the card describes the human label as an overall safety label for the conversation; 852 of the 1964 test rows also have a model response (meta.has_response; 242 yes and 195 no rows here), which is not shown in the state. meta.violated_categories is the data set's category list. The prompts contain harmful and offensive text. Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 34 of 1000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 12 more to restore the balance of the classes; 954 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 108 of 954 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 10 more to restore the balance of the classes; 836 items remain.
